candidates.name: CURL EXPLORER (Thew)
candidates.description: A GPU particle toy that advects 4,194,304 particles through the curl of several selectable noise fields (Wombit/Sharpe-style noise with analytic derivatives; 'sworley' is tuned for strong Y-directional spirals). Click/drag/wheel moves the camera; a dropdown switches noise types and the curl operator reshapes the flow.
candidates.creator: Thew (graphics.thew.nu)

licensing.notes: Personal experiment page; no license stated on the page. Relies on Brian Sharpe's Wombat noise project per the page text.

candidates.research_notes: Exa fetch returned the page's full descriptive copy. The strongest pure curl-noise reference found: demonstrates curl-of-noise flow fields at extreme particle counts, directly reusable as a reference implementation pattern for a flow-field subcategory.
candidates.otxyn_potential: High as a curl-noise flow-field archetype; big particle counts impress, but noise-derivative math needs careful porting and licensing check before reuse.
